cards.answer: Kayn is a fighter/assassin who can move through terrain and hide inside a damaged enemy before bursting out. His abilities deal physical damage and scale with AD; Rhaast heals through ability damage, while Shadow Assassin adds opening burst damage.
cards.counterplay: Watch nearby walls and avoid isolated fights; disengage from Rhaast's sustained fighting and respect Shadow Assassin's opening burst.

cards.answer: Champion damage and takedowns earn progress toward a permanent transformation into Rhaast or Shadow Assassin. Rhaast heals from physical ability damage dealt to champions. Shadow Assassin adds bonus magic damage briefly upon entering champion combat, refreshing after time out of champion combat.
cards.counterplay: Avoid unnecessary trades before his transformation; limit extended fights against Rhaast and respect Shadow Assassin when he reengages.

cards.answer: Shadow Step grants movement speed and movement through terrain, healing Kayn when he first enters terrain during the cast. Champion combat sharply shortens its duration, and immobilization cancels it. Shadow Assassin gains slow resistance, greater movement speed in terrain, and a shorter cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Watch wall approaches; pressure him with champion damage or immobilizing crowd control to limit his terrain movement.

cards.answer: Umbral Trespass targets a champion Kayn recently damaged, hiding him inside them while he is untargetable and revealing the target. He exits in a chosen direction and deals physical damage. Rhaast's damage and healing depend on the target's maximum health; Shadow Assassin gains cast and exit range and refreshes his passive burst when emerging.
cards.counterplay: Avoid letting him damage you before an engage; if he enters you, move toward allied support and prepare for his exit.
